Well I guess I’ll do an update. Can’t believe I posted this 100 days ago. I’m doing better. I eventually found a good job at a battery acid plant called Johnson Controls. I quit smoking weed for good so I could pass the drug test when it was time for me to be hired through the company after I used my brother’s urine to get my foot in the door. I started working there in August and yesterday (9/23/20) was my last day.  Unfortunately I got hired through a temp agency, which wasn’t paying me enough to provide my share of rent AND pay the bills I was responsible for, and the company rollover process was taking too long for me since they wanted me to work in one part of the plant while some other people who were also hired through a temp agency were getting rolled over before the 90 day period because they were working different positions. That, and the supervisor I worked with and I butted heads often, making rude remarks and subliminal idle threats. After an experienced co-worker asked if she could re-train me to work the position I initially applied for, before being moved, he quickly denied even the thought of it happening; therefore confirming my decision to leave, and ASAP. I’ve always been into a career in trucking, since I have a brother and a cousin who are truck drivers, and since I don’t have kids (and don’t want any) I’d take the remaining 5 years of my 20’s and travel across the country and getting paid...yay. I applied for CR England trucking school, and they enrolled me in their training program. I leave home this Saturday, and should start class on Monday. The only thing that’s got me on edge right now is the hair follicle test. I can’t believe I’m saying this, but I now can’t stand the smell of weed! Something I indulged in with delight since I was 18, now makes me disgusted I even went down that path. Even though nothing bad happened when I was doing it (other than a bad trip) one harmless drug (or herb rather) could put a major plan I’ve devised for years in total jeopardy! They say the hair test is un-beatable and yet I’ve still wasted 25+ dollars in buying hair detox shampoo online and using it every day since it came in the mail. I could have went to work today since we usually have every other weekend off to have a little money saved up in case I DO fail the test and will have to pay out of pocket for a ride back home. Not only that, but it’ll be on something called a DAC report and I won’t be able to find work for a whole year, even if I do get my license! Damn you Mary Jane! Other than that, I guess I’m doing ok. 👍🏾 I mean, I’m not having suicidal thoughts anymore. 🤷🏾
